config.name: SkarionGIS · utility asset data and closeout
config.market: U.S. utility GIS managers, owner-operators, engineering primes and asset teams; English
config.goal: Find proven examples of explaining data readiness, source-to-asset traceability and bounded migration QA.
exclude: fiber route design with no GIS deliverable

observations.summary: The post opens with a buyer-facing readiness question, names geometric and model-rule issues, and offers an assessment followed by a cleanup roadmap.
A public event update invites operators to discuss construction handoffs and bringing field updates into their system of record. It makes the workflow the reason to talk.
The firm describes utility conversations around migration, scanned easements, aligning assets with LiDAR and keeping as-built data current, using the event as a setting for concrete use cases.
Its telecom page names source-linked trackable outputs such as record drawings, asset and evidence indexes, geospatial files and exceptions. It shows where the client owns verification.

observations.publisher: American Public Power Association / SSP Innovations feature
observations.summary: This paid feature uses Lincoln Electric System's planned migration to explain data preparation and how different utility teams use the network. Use it as positioning evidence.
Its sanitary sewer example walks through planning, migration, staging and implementation. The chapters organize a complex subject around decisions a utility team can follow.
observations.metrics_context: Count observed in the public search index. The platform measurement date was unavailable.

payload.performance_read: The Cloudpoint video has visible historical counts and demonstrates a deep technical format. The indexed counts and unmeasured LinkedIn posts do not supply a matched comparison. The sponsored article provides messaging evidence only.

tests.idea: Test a five-slide readiness check. Hook: “Would this asset survive your next GIS import?” Show one duplicated ID, one missing source and one unresolved connection. Offer a worksheet for a single layer review
tests.success_metric: qualified requests for a one-layer QA scope or source schema discussion

tests.idea: Test a 45-second map-to-source recording. Select one synthetic asset, find its revision and evidence reference, then show what the exception queue sends to the prime. Offer the source crosswalk
tests.success_metric: qualified crosswalk requests and invitations to review a real data batch
